structural_breaks.note: CG Power USA Inc. (Washington, Missouri transformer plant; renamed WEG Transformers USA) acquired — announced 21-Jun-2017, consolidated from Aug-2017 (3T17 release: 'eliminados os efeitos da consolidação da aquisição da CG Power USA'). Adds US-made transformers to GTD external.
TGM (Brazilian steam-turbine maker) control acquisition approved by CADE 28-Feb-2018 and consolidated into GTD (Brazil) from 1T18.
Agreement with TSEA to buy its Betim/MG power-transformer plant (32,500 m², power transformers, shunt reactors, autotransformers) — GTD Brazil capacity.

Data-availability break: absolute GTD revenue (Mercado Interno/Externo) is printed in releases only from 2T20 (with 2T19-4T19 and 1T20 as comparatives/prior quarter). Earlier releases give only qualitative/percent business-area commentary; no GTD values before FY2019Q2.
Regal Rexnord industrial motors & generators businesses (Marathon, Rotor, Cemp) consolidated from May-2024; generators (Marathon) enter GTD external (29.7% of the acquired revenue in 2T24 = GTD).
Reivax (excitation/control systems) and Volt Electric Motors consolidation effects cited in 1T25 release when adjusting growth.

profile.products: GTD business area: oil-immersed power transformers, shunt reactors and autotransformers (Betim/MG plant bought from TSEA in 2020), distribution and power transformers (Blumenau/SC, Gravataí/RS — voltage classes up to 230 kV per WEG news 2024), substations/E-houses, specialty transformers 1–10 MVA up to 46.5 kV in Washington, Missouri (WEG Transformers USA, ex-CG Power USA), hydro/thermal generators, steam turbines (TGM), wind turbines, distributed & centralized solar; since May-2024 Marathon generators (US data-center backup power). Consolidated revenue also includes industrial motors/drives (EEI), commercial motors (MCA) and paints (T&V).

collection_notes: revenue_total Q1–Q3: CVM ITR 'DF Consolidado – Demonstração do Resultado' conta 3.01 3-month column via CVM open data (dados.cvm.gov.br itr_cia_aberta_DRE_con_YYYY.csv, latest filing version); prior_year_comparative = PENÚLTIMO 3-month column of the same filing. Q4: 4T release headline table (direct 3-month figure), cross-checked = DFP annual minus ITR 9M for every year 2016–2025 (all identical to the thousand).

GTD: sum of the two printed market columns (Mercado Interno + Mercado Externo) of the 'Desempenho por Área de Negócio – GTD' table; every quarter printed in more than one release (as current, previous quarter and prior-year row) was checked for consistency — no restatements found.
Values converted from R$ mil to R$ milhões (÷1000). No FX conversion. GTD external is in BRL and therefore contains USD/MXN/COP translation effects.
